text:
Here's the audit, most severe first.

## Critical

1. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:9` blocks snippets on every page.** The default robots value is `max-snippet:0`. Every page without a `robots` prop (home and moorings) tells Google and AI search not to show any text snippet. Fix: default to `index, follow, max-snippet:-1, max-image-preview:large`, or drop the tag.

2. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:8` gives every page the same canonical, `https://harbor.example/`.** `/moorings` and `/contact` both declare the homepage as canonical, so search engines may drop them from the index. Fix: build it from the page URL, for example `new URL(Astro.url.pathname, Astro.site)`. Also set `site` in `astro.config.*`, which doesn't exist in the repo.

3. **`src/data/faq.json:8` has a broken key.** The first answer uses `" "` instead of `"acceptedAnswer"`. The first FAQ question is therefore invalid and has no answer in the structured data. Fix: rename the key to `acceptedAnswer`.

4. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:9` has invalid JSON-LD.** The trailing comma after `"headline": "Moorings and prices",` makes the block unparseable, so the Article markup is ignored. Fix: remove the comma. Better, generate it with `set:html={JSON.stringify(...)}` as `index.astro:8` does. Add `author`, `datePublished` and `dateModified` too.

## High

5. **`public/robots.txt:4-8` blocks AI search crawlers.** `OAI-SearchBot` (ChatGPT search) and `PerplexityBot` are disallowed, so the site can't be cited in those answers. Fix: remove both blocks, unless this is deliberate. If it is, say so, and be aware it costs you AI search visibility. Blocking training bots such as `GPTBot` is a separate choice and doesn't affect search citations.

6. **`src/pages/contact.astro:4` is set to `noindex`.** The contact page, which is the conversion page for a harbour office, won't appear in search. Fix: remove `robots="noindex"` unless that's intended. Also add `LocalBusiness` or `Organization` schema with the address, phone and opening hours. The phone number at `contact.astro:6` is only plain text.

## Medium

7. **`src/pages/index.astro:8` puts the FAQ markup on a page that doesn't show the FAQ.** The page has no visible FAQ text, and FAQPage markup must match visible content. The data is also imported into the home page but looks like it belongs on `/moorings`. Fix: render the Q&As in the page body, or move the markup to the page that shows them.

8. **`src/pages/index.astro:5-7` has thin content and a title mismatch.** The title says "Harbor … Cornwall" and the H1 says "Falmouth", with spelling varying between "Harbor" and "harbour". Aim for one consistent spelling, matching what users search for in the UK. The page is two short sentences, so there's little for AI engines to quote. Add concrete facts: mooring counts, prices, the water taxi season (May to September, currently only in the FAQ), location and how to book.

9. **`src/pages/moorings.astro:7` is the only place that states prices.** "From £40 a night" is one line. Add a table with mooring sizes and seasonal prices to match the description at line 5. Use `Offer` or `Product` schema if you want rich results.

10. **`src/layouts/Base.astro:2-7` has no social or share metadata.** There are no `og:title`, `og:description`, `og:image`, `og:url` or `twitter:card` tags, and no `<meta charset>` or `<meta name="viewport">`. Fix: add them to the layout.

## Low

11. **`public/sitemap.xml:3-5` has no `<lastmod>`, and it includes `/contact`.** If you keep the noindex from item 6, remove `/contact` from the sitemap, because noindex pages shouldn't be listed. Otherwise add `<lastmod>`. Consider `@astrojs/sitemap` so the file is generated and can't drift. It isn't in `package.json`.

12. **`src/components/Newsletter.jsx:2` has an unnamed form that does nothing.** The form has no `action` or `name` on the input, and `client:load` at `moorings.astro:11` hydrates JavaScript for it on page load. Use `client:visible` or `client:idle`. Give the button `type="submit"` and wire up an action.

13. **No `llms.txt` and no site-wide structured data.** Nothing in the repo describes the site to AI crawlers or marks up the organisation. Add `public/llms.txt` with a short summary and links to the key pages, and `Organization` or `LocalBusiness` JSON-LD in `Base.astro`.

14. **Page titles and descriptions are short.** Examples are `index.astro:5` and `contact.astro:4`. Include the location and the main keyword, and keep descriptions to roughly 120 to 160 characters.

I only read the files; I haven't changed anything. I can apply the fixes for items 1 to 4, which are mechanical, if you'd like. Items 5 and 6 depend on whether you meant to block those crawlers and hide the contact page.
